editorialNotes.short: “It was a privilege.” TSHA takes Defected’s In The House series forward.
editorialNotes.standard: For TSHA, creating this mix was, as the UK DJ/producer tells Apple Music, a “huge pleasure and privilege.” And that’s because of who the request came from: The British indie house label Defected Records. In 2024, the label turned 25, which proved the perfect opportunity to relaunch their celebrated In The House DJ series, a showcase of the best house music of the moment and the future. For TSHA, Defected Records are “such an iconic symbol of house music,” and this mix spotlights both what’s come before and what’s on TSHA’s radar now. “This mix for me was a chance to delve into the records that have helped pioneer dance music, but was also a platform for me to showcase some incredible newcomers whose music I wanted to celebrate,” she says. “I hope you have as much fun listening as I did creating!”

editorialNotes.short: This previously unreleased mix captures the late DJ’s “quintessential sound.”
editorialNotes.standard: “As stewards of Frankie Knuckles’ legacy, we are thrilled and deeply honored to share this previously unreleased project with his legion of fans,” Frederick Dunson, founder of the Frankie Knuckles Foundation, tells Apple Music. This soulful mix from the late club legend finds a home here as part of the Defected Presents… series and features shimmering house cuts from Hardsoul, Finishing Touch, Deetron, and Knuckles himself. “It beautifully captures his quintessential sound in 2011—which has become synonymous with his name—mixed in classical FK style!” Dunson says. “We thank you for your continued outpouring of love of him and your support.”
